regions.name: Northern areas: Sahel
regions.where: The Sahelian belt of central Chad (no locator map on the image)
regions.notes: Lean box runs Jun to mid-Sep. Green harvest (teal, mid-Sep to Oct) excluded. Off-season land preparation (Oct-Nov) and weeding (mid-Oct to Dec) are shown, but no off-season harvest bar.

regions.name: Southern areas
regions.where: The Sudanian south of Chad (no locator map on the image)
regions.notes: Rainy shading mid-May to mid-Oct. Main harvest mid-Sep to mid-Dec. Lean box Jun to mid-Aug. Berbere (Jan-Feb) and Rice (Jun) bars share one 'Berbere and Rice Harvest' row with no season label, so rainy is null. Green harvest (teal, mid-Aug to Sep) excluded.

assign.method: No locator maps: assigned by geography. The 7 Sudanian southern provinces plus Salamat go to southern; the Sahelian belt goes to northern-sahel. The Saharan provinces (Borkou, Tibesti, Ennedi Est/Ouest) are in neither block and go to northern-sahel at low confidence.

transcriber_notes: Convention: this template snaps edges to whole or half months; an edge at mid-month is treated as covering half of that month and so the month is included (schema rule 'at least half'). No locator maps, so the Sahel/south split is my own reading of the block titles. Salamat (Sudano-Sahelian, rains from about May) is placed in southern at low confidence. Chari-Baguirmi, Guéra and Sila straddle the transition and go to northern-sahel at medium.
